review_state: production rev 1 - M1, awaiting owner look review
purpose: Creature eye part (PROPOSED): a big expressive eye with a chestnut iris under a heavy upper lid fringed with five bold upcurled lashes; blinks and bulges on shape keys.

textures.name: T_PartEyeLashed_Albedo
textures.packing: greyscale albedo detail (baked AO darkens crevices), times each material's base colour

textures.name: T_PartEyeLashed_ORM
textures.packing: R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

handles.meaning: the heavy upper lid and its lashes swing down over the ball to meet the lower lid, which rises a little

part_rules.handles_note: H1_Blink is on EyeLashedLid and EyeLashedLashes with the same name (the upper lid and its lashes swing down together on a hinge through the eye's corners); H2_Bulge is on the ball, EyeLashed. Both are 0 to 1000 per mille.

reduction.method: Blender collapse decimation within a surface tolerance; full-detail shading baked to the normal map

review_notes.gate1_shape: pass: a big ball 10 cm across set in the skin to about its middle, seen through an almond opening in one smooth lid ring that runs back into the skin like a socket - heavy and rolled above (covering the iris's top), thin below, meeting at the two corners; seven bold flat tapered lashes reach forward off the upper margin and flick up, fanning toward the corners (face-on, gray_top, they read as a fringe over the eye). H1_Blink swings the upper lid and lashes down on a hinge through the corners to meet the lower lid (some soft creasing at full close); H2_Bulge pushes the ball out. Iterated: the first build wrapped two thin lid shells round the whole ball and read as a cracked eggshell with spidery lashes (1588 triangles); the second still creased where the two lids met and its lashes curled back over the lid like claws.
review_notes.gate2_materials: pass: four finishes - a glossy white sclera with faint veins, a wide chestnut iris with radial fibres, a dark limbal ring and a big black pupil, soft warm skin on the lid with fine pores, and near-black glossy lashes.
review_notes.gate3_neutral_light: pass: under the neutral white rig the ball's highlight sits on the iris, the lid's roll reads by its soft shading, the lashes stay dark against the lid without crushing; no clipping.
review_notes.gate4_godot: unverified: not yet seen in the creature editor (more_parts_shots.gd)

provenance: Authored procedurally in Blender by tools/blender/make_more_creature_parts.py, with helpers from tools/blender/make_creature_parts.py; no external or generated meshes. Textures baked in Blender from procedural shaders.
